To confirm these correspond to CH₃ groups (and not CH₂), I’ll retrieve the HSQC spectrum, which correlates each carbon with its directly attached protons. Methyl carbons will show a single‑proton cross‑peak (integrating to three protons). This will let me verify the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
